class.name: PerformanceBudget
class.brief_description: A list of performance limits that a recorded run must stay within.

method.name: check_summary
method.description: Checks every rule against [param summary] and returns the failures. A rule fails if its statistic is greater than [member PerformanceBudgetRule.limit], if its column was not recorded, or if the column has no samples. Empty entries of [member rules] are skipped.

method.name: get_rule_count
method.description: Returns the number of entries in [member rules], including empty ones.
